li.label: won the wager
li.description: I won the bet, and the council saw that it was paid. I could get used to luck like that.

li.label: lost a bet and had to pay
li.description: Pay up, the council said. I still say the game wasn't straight.

li.label: lost double or nothing
li.description: I let it ride on one more round, and lost the lot.

li.label: gambling banned
li.description: No more cards or dice, by order of the council. Now the evenings are just sitting in the dark, listening for raiders.

li.label: met halfway
li.description: I got some of what I asked for, and not the rest. I'm meant to be grateful.

li.label: my things were confiscated
li.description: What was mine went into the common stores, on the council's say. I had plans for every bit of it.

li.label: kept my collection
li.description: They came, looked over my collection, and let me keep every piece.

li.label: my keepsake was broken
li.description: My keepsake got broken. It was the last thing I had from before.

li.label: made to apologize in public
li.description: I had to say sorry with the others watching. I hated every word of it.

li.label: compensated for my loss
li.description: I was paid for it, coin by coin. It doesn't undo anything, but they took it seriously.

li.label: a poor copy
li.description: They made me a new one, and it's a poor copy. I keep it next to the pieces of the old one.

li.label: a bad omen
li.description: One of us dreamed of fire. I keep sniffing the air for smoke.

li.label: the council believes in dreams
li.description: The council is making decisions based on a bad dream. I don't like it.

li.label: a good laugh
li.description: One of the others made a complete fool of themselves. I laughed until I cried.

li.label: burned our fears
li.description: We scratched our fears into scraps of wood and threw them on the fire. I slept well afterward.

li.label: told to keep quiet
li.description: I know what I saw, and the council told me to keep it to myself.

li.label: repaid an old kindness
li.description: I finally repaid an old kindness. They know now that I never forgot.

li.label: couldn't repay an old kindness
li.description: They saved my life once, and I never got to repay them.

li.label: the council gave our things away
li.description: We scrape for every coin and crumb, and the council gives it away.

li.label: disciplined by the council
li.description: I made one mistake, and now the council has me hauling and scrubbing until my arms fall off.

li.label: nobody's watching the gate
li.description: The night watch was caught asleep, and the council let them off easy.

li.label: put in charge
li.description: The council put me in charge. I've already made a list of everything that needs fixing.

li.label: being bossed around
li.description: Ever since the council put one of them in charge, I've been ordered around all day.

li.label: I have a title now
li.description: Warden, they call me now. I've started walking differently, and people have noticed.

li.label: someone else got the honor
li.description: One of us got singled out for honors. I work just as hard as they do.

li.label: refused a seat at the table
li.description: I offered to help run the colony, and the council turned me down.

li.label: sat through a council meeting
li.description: The council meeting dragged on for hours, mostly about latrines. My legs went numb.

li.label: they smashed my work
li.description: They took a hammer to my work. All those hours, gone.

li.label: my face is a joke
li.description: That ugly likeness of me stands where we eat, grinning with my own crooked teeth. I see it every meal.

li.label: a flattering likeness
li.description: They carved me looking heroic. My chin has never been that chin. I love it.

li.label: my music was banned
li.description: My music is banned at night now. All I hear is snoring and the wind.

li.label: watched a good fight
li.description: We watched two of them settle it with their fists, and somebody's tooth came loose. Best evening in weeks.

li.label: the council stopped the fight
li.description: The council stopped the fight before it started. Now it'll never be settled.

li.label: took what was coming
li.description: I did something terrible once. Now I'm paying for it, and I'm glad to.

li.label: settled an old score
li.description: I've carried that grudge for years. Now I've finally hit them for it, and the council looked away.

li.label: used to be a raider
li.description: They used to raid settlements like ours. Now they pass me the salt at dinner.
